data.scope: synthetic arbitrary associations, not scientific or Registry facts

design.akinator_scope: initial family deficit diagnostic, fixed stages not autonomous curriculum discovery
design.comparison: seeded random prechoice vs calibrated prechoice vs observed-best current-gate oracle; all receive both exact probes and same feedback diagnostics; calibrated prediction adds .2 EWMA error correction from preceding informative paired outcomes; no lookahead for calibrated choice; actual gate CE improvement subject to exact retention veto; raw rank measured on same states, not a separate trajectory
design.equal_work: same curriculum/replay, one objective backward and eight VJPs, five diagnostic projections and two actual candidate probes per trial; matched active dimension and gate positions; wall time measured
design.foundation_gate: each primitive family >=50% terminated exact and >=parent; zero old pair/open/historical losses; relation threshold separate
design.generation: full 258-token greedy autoregression, newline required, max 7 tokens, no choices or retrieval
design.geometry_policy: all arms same frozen parent group metric, .50->.625->.75 staged expansion with prior five accepted updates and five percent gate CE improvement since previous cap, boundary crossing, unchanged semantic veto and minimum current CE gain; absolute Euclidean cap and .07 step cap
design.group_metric: five disjoint parameter groups; sqrt(group normalized-gradient RMS/global RMS), clamp [.7,1.4]; weighted L2 plus hard Euclidean cap; not Hessian or individual sensitivity
design.moment_policy: moments follow raw clipped objective gradient for all accepted proposals; exact optimizer rollback on veto/zero
design.plasticity: both equal-size transformer blocks receive isolated actual AdamW probes at identical starting state; restore model and optimizer after each probe; commit at most one exact admissible candidate; all five group diagnostics, protected projection and adaptive geometry retained
design.projection: 24 cyclic homogeneous halfspace sweeps in double precision Gram space, zero displacement on infeasible; current-model 4 pair + 4 open (>=2 historical) normals, actual AdamW shadow displacement
design.retention: old pair and old open, plus 16 parent-correct historical open witnesses per gate and separate exam
design.trinity_scope: local deterministic proposal and veto predicates, not external model verification

limitations: All six acquisition gates failed. Corrected ranking 166/174 versus raw 23/174 on same calibrated states, not independent raw training trajectory.
